All the cores have been centralized to a single CCX design, which means data travelling time and latency speeds have greatly improved. The compatibility with an X570 or B550 AMD board makes the processor even more popular among gamers, who like the hassle-free experience.
There are also many technological updates to look forward to, like an optimized boosting algorithm and improved memory overclocking. Along with the CCX design, you also get a redesigned cache system to solve all your latency issues. No wonder fans prefer this to the Intel Core i5-10600K!
